sentences.text: This ancient creature belongs to a primitive group of bird-hipped dinosaurs that might be related to the family Patagopterygidae.
Scientists place it within the unranked order known as Patagopterygiformes.
Federico L. Agnolin and Agustín G. Martinelli named the genus in 2009, establishing the species Alamitornis minutus as the reference specimen.
Remains were uncovered in the Upper Cretaceous Los Alamitos Formation located in the Río Negro Province of Argentina.
The animal lived during the Maastrichtian stage, roughly 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
